title: 3 Mythology Realms People Mix Up
script: This is Valhalla. This is Folkvangr. So what's the difference? Valhalla takes half the slain warriors to Odin hall, while Folkvangr takes the other half of fallen warriors to Freya field. This is Asgard. This is Midgard. So what's the difference? Asgard is the heavenly realm of Gods, while Midgard is the earthly realm of mortals. This is Tartarus. This is Underworld. So what's the difference? Tartarus is a subterranean abyss punishing Titans, while Underworld is the general realm of all deceased souls ruled by Hades. Follow for more.
